//: The VIP events (docs/vip.md): which packs exist and from when, read by tools/levels/events.mts. Each entry is one event of 30 levels of its own: `id` (lower case, never reused; its levels are <id>-01..30), `release` (the day VIPs can first play it; it never closes), `items` (Art's 2x2 item pictures, slot order, 10, each in one event only: item k hides on level 2, 5, 8 ... 29) and, for a set of items drawn for a month, `month` (Art's monthly theme and table in pictures.json `suitcases`; otherwise Art's `events` entry for the id). Events run in release order; back to back, a gap or none are all just entries. After an edit: node tools/levels/make-events.mts (it keeps every level already made), then check.mts.
